answer: An farming party thus has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 11 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The tide counter is kept in forge and shale exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 11 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4935 identities would post 4090 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
